description: This PHP source file defines the class FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategy, which implements the EntitlementConsumptionStrategy interface within the Leave Entitlement module of the OrangeHRM system. It handles FIFO (First-In-First-Out) logic for leave entitlement consumption, including managing leave creation, cancellations, period changes, and entitlement date limits, utilizing various services and DAO classes.

classes.name: FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategy
classes.description: Implements FIFO logic for leave entitlement consumption in OrangeHRM, managing leave create, cancel, period change, and entitlement limits.

methods.name: getDao
methods.description: Initialized and returns the DAO object responsible for data operations related to FIFO entitlement consumption.

methods.name: handleLeaveCreate
methods.description: Processes the creation of leave entries, deducting entitlement days using FIFO approach, and returns the current and changed entitlements.

methods.name: handleEntitlementStatusChange
methods.description: Placeholder for handling changes in entitlement status; currently not implemented.

methods.name: handleLeaveCancel
methods.description: Handles leave cancellation by restoring entitlement days and updating related records accordingly.

methods.name: handleLeavePeriodChange
methods.description: Handles updates to leave periods, often triggered by calendar or policy adjustments.

methods.name: getLeaveWithoutEntitlementDateLimitsForLeaveBalance
methods.description: Calculates date limits for leaves without entitlements within a specified balance period.

methods.name: getLeavePeriod
methods.description: Fetches the current leave period for a given date, employee, and leave type.
